dataset_info.summary: Recordings of people saying “alexa” from Picovoice's public wake-word benchmark, used as the clips a detector must wake on, against negatives pooled from the shared not-wake-word collection. One row is one clip with its label. This is an independently collected set, which makes it a useful check on engines tuned against their own vendor's data. Runs on this corpus are capped at 100 clips per class, drawn the same way for every fighter, and 100 more spoken-word clips join the negatives.
dataset_info.notes: Picovoice wake-word benchmark — real 'alexa' recordings (data/alexa/) as positives; negatives pooled across the not-wake-word collection.
